alternativesConsidered.name: 1995 Chicago Review Press trade-paper reissue
alternativesConsidered.notes: Official current product page for the same core work family. Useful for metadata and summary support, but the 1993 first edition is the cleaner chapter-map lock.

alternativesConsidered.name: Google Books work-family page
alternativesConsidered.notes: Authorized preview page confirms the same title family and table of contents but is not as stable as the first-edition bibliographic record for edition lock purposes.

decisionRationale: Open Library exposes the 1993 Chicago Review Press first-edition identifiers, pagination, and one visible excerpt, which makes it the strongest edition lock in the lawful bundle.
Google Books and the CCLS Syndetics table of contents match the same chapter order from Introduction through Epilogue.
The 1995 Chicago Review Press product page reflects a later reissue of the same work family, not a materially different chapter structure.
No translation or materially different chapter order was found that would change chapter-level scope or interpretation.
